design: Same 25 QMSum train questions and positive passages, one epoch, batch 2, cached-loss mini-batch 1, 256 training tokens, learning rate 1e-5, seed 42, CUDA. Only the negative changes.
snapshot_line_endings: The recorded GPU control run used CRLF on Windows. The checked-in LF file is byte-identical after replacing CRLF with LF; all 25 parsed JSON objects are unchanged.
interpretation: The reviewed negatives beat the matched random control on validation, but the gain over the reference is small and Hit@5 falls. The reference checkpoint remains the final agent model. The random control is excluded from QMSum gold spans but was not semantically reviewed; these 25 examples do not establish statistical significance or generalization.
